display_name: DURA 源 IQ 小扰动保留诊断
description: 用 DURA 估计物理作用将源 clean IQ 的四种 1% RMS 合成扰动映射到 received，重新恢复并测量扰动响应。
authorization: User authorizes ongoing Phase1 F-free restoration research, source-only diagnostics and GPU use.

code.environment: N607 CPU two threads, CUDA disabled, nice 10

data.representation: 672 fixed source pilot paired received/clean IQ, frozen DURA output
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 672 previously explored source pilot IDs disjoint from 32768 prior fit IDs

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored 672 source pilot; not an independent blind test
data.leo_config_ref: Source fixed epoch19 seven simulated views

permissions.claim_scope: Synthetic small perturbation response under estimated DURA action on source IQ only; not transmitter identity, target accuracy or a universal bound

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed source-only DURA, no model updates
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Fixed DURA source-only checkpoint and 672 source L_s/U_s pilot IDs
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: DURA source-only with no F/TX/V/target ancestry

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only 2 threads, nice 10, preserve all existing owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source role mismatch, nonfinite output or loss, target/F/TX access or technical failure; do not change other jobs

expected_artifacts: result.json: 14 source groups x four synthetic perturbations x action and full DURA response

dimensions: RX4/6 and RX8 x seven views x 48
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: none; no target or TX truth

rows.method: Finite source-IQ directional perturbation through fixed estimated action and reestimated DURA
rows.purpose: Measure whether specified artificial source waveform changes survive the recovery mapping without an identity classifier
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source pilot and DURA, deterministic constructed directions, no training or new randomness
rows.scenario: fixed previously explored source pilot grouped by RX and source simulation view
rows.budget_ref: 672 source records x four fixed perturbations plus baseline; no target access or model updates
expected_artifacts: result.json: 14 source groups x four synthetic perturbations x action and full DURA response

notes: Source clean IQ is used only to construct four controlled perturbation directions; not available as deployed input.
DURA-estimated action is held fixed to inject the perturbation; DURA itself reestimates the action for each changed received signal.
Directions are artificial proxies, not actual transmitter identity or frozen classifier sensitivity.
No F, TX labels, V or target data; first batch checks actual fixed checkpoint replay.
